2610.08514.title: How Much Evidence Should a Coding Agent's Self-Correction Carry? Adaptive Dirichlet Evidence for Self-Distillation
2610.08514.paper_summary: Execution feedback lets coding agents revise programs and learn from their own corrections. A correction's learning weight should reflect both the transitions supported by its executions and the amount of evidence behind that support. We introduce Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD), which represents these quantities separately. Normalized execution relevance determines relative transition support and an effective pseudo-count mass; a Dirichlet posterior then produces an uncertainty-penalized weight for KL-anchored correction learning. Under a symmetric prior, changing mass preserves category ordering, and effective mass yields a supervised coefficient bounded by its matched fixed-mass counterpart. Across four model-domain history sweeps, increasing visible observations from one to eight reduces future-outcome NLL by 55.0-59.3%. At eight observations, effective mass achieves lower NLL than fixed mass in all four comparisons. In the primary matched DeepSeek/RunBugRun study, argmax predictions agree on all 3,000 examples, with the largest NLL gain under concentrated relevance. After one correction-learning round, DeepSeek/CodeARC all-tests Pass@1 increases from 15.0% to 20.4%, with a paired 95% source-bootstrap interval of [+2.8, +8.0] percentage points. The twelve-setting downstream evaluation establishes the model-domain scope of this update. These results show how separating evidence support from evidence mass changes probability estimation and correction learning in coding agents.
2610.08514.paper_summary_zh: 執行反饋讓編碼代理能夠修訂程式並從自己的修正中學習。修正的學習權重應該反映其執行所支持的轉換以及該支持背後的證據量。我們引入了有效證據自我蒸餾（Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation, EESD），它分別表示這些量。標準化的執行相關性決定相對的轉換支持和有效的偽計數質量；然後，Dirichlet 後驗生成一個不確定性懲罰的權重，用於以 KL 為基礎的修正學習。在對稱先驗下，改變質量保持類別排序，有效質量產生一個由其匹配的固定質量對應物所界定的監督係數。在四次模型-領域歷史掃描中，從一個可見觀察增加到八個，未來結果的 NLL 減少了 55.0-59.3%。在八個觀察下，有效質量在所有四個比較中達到比固定質量更低的 NLL。在主要的匹配 DeepSeek/RunBugRun 研究中，argmax 預測在所有 3,000 個範例中一致，在集中相關性下獲得最大的 NLL 增益。在一次修正學習回合後，DeepSeek/CodeARC 所有測試的 Pass@1 從 15.0% 增加到 20.4%，配對的 95% 來源自助區間為 [+2.8, +8.0] 個百分點。這十二個設置的下游評估確立了此更新的模型-領域範圍。這些結果顯示，將證據支持與證據質量分開如何改變編碼代理的概率估計和修正學習。
